blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Feedback often arrives while a task is still in progress. A program execution reveals that a proposed transformation is wrong. A completed workflow provides evidence about a later job. The next decision can use this observation through additional context, a stored record, or a change in the parameters that participate in the computation. LARC implements this last path through a small residual attached to a hidden representation. The question is whether retaining its feedback updates improves a later read, and under which learning conditions.
blocks.zh: 在一项任务仍在进行时,往往会收到反馈。 一个程序执行显示,一个拟议的转换是错误的. 已完成的工作流程为以后的工作提供了证据。 下一个决定可以通过额外的上下文,存储的记录,或者参与计算参数的变化来使用这个观察. LARC通过一个隐藏的表示物上附着的少量剩余物来执行这一最后的路径. 问题是保留其反馈更新是否改进了后读,以及学习条件。

blocks.en: Consider a learner given four complete programs, one of which is the target. It assigns a probability to each candidate, and an executor returns all four errors on the available examples. A gradient update can reduce the probability-weighted error even when the next prompt and the most likely candidate remain unchanged. This setting makes a numerical feedback effect measurable without requiring program generation. It also raises concrete implementation questions: where is the change stored, how does it reach the next prediction, how long is it retained, and what behavior returns when it is removed? A learning state needs an initialization, an update process, a reader, and a lifetime.
blocks.zh: 考虑学习者给四个完整的课程,其中一个是目标。 它为每个候选人分配一个概率,一个执行者返回所有四个可用示例的错误. 梯度更新可以减少概率加权误差,即使下一个即时和最有可能的候选人保持不变。 这个设置使得一个数字反馈效果可以测量而不需要程序生成. 这也提出了具体的执行问题:变化存储在哪里,它如何达到下一个预测,它保留了多久,被移除后有什么行为回报? 学习状态需要初始化,更新过程,读者,以及一生.

blocks.en: The separation between ρ \rho and Φ \Phi gives the learner two timescales, following the distinction between slow parameters and fast weights [ 1 ] . Slow training shapes a starting representation across tasks. Fast updates respond to observations in the current episode. Resetting to the trained ρ \rho removes those fast updates while preserving what slow training has learned. For this input residual, learning requires a gradient through the downstream mixer: its weights stay fixed, but its response to a changed input determines how the factors should change.

blocks.en: MMLA separates a numerical policy carrier from an authoritative memory carrier and assigns them distinct writers and reset domains [ 17 ] . LARC supplies a concrete realization of the policy carrier. Its interface is hidden-to-hidden; the mixer that follows it is a separate architectural choice. The present implementation reuses a Transformer language-model mixer as the frozen substrate. The residual interface and its learning lifetime carry the definition, while this mixer supplies the computation used in the experiments.
blocks.zh: MMLA将数字政策载体与权威内存载体区分开来,并指定它们分别的写法和重置域 [17]. LARC提供了政策载体的具体实现. 它的接口是隐藏到隐藏的;后面的混音器是一个单独的建筑选择. 目前的实施将变形器语言模型混合器作为冷冻底物重新使用。 剩余接口及其学习寿命带有这个定义,而这个搅拌器则提供实验中使用的计算.

blocks.en: Our central empirical comparison trains two initializations using the same feedback, queries, residual placement, and paired random seeds. One objective evaluates queries at the slow initialization. The other evaluates them after two feedback updates, using a first-order MAML-style estimator. For each trained seed, retaining real-feedback updates reduces expected query error on held-out development parameter groups. The advantage of one training objective over the other is less consistent across seeds, and the direct symbolic rule remains much more accurate than either arm. We then follow the static initialization into a task-matched continuous-integration study, where preserving online updates is harmful relative to reset on the recorded queue. The contrast shows why feedback responsiveness, the quality of the starting policy, and sustained online benefit need separate measurements.
blocks.zh: 我们的中央经验比较训练了两个初始化,使用相同的反馈,查询,剩余放置,以及配对的随机种子. 有一个目标评价初始化缓慢的询问。 另一个则在两次反馈更新后评价它们,使用一阶的MAML风格的估算器. 对于每个训练好的种子,保留真实反馈更新会减少被搁置开发参数组的预期查询错误. 一个训练目标相对于另一个训练目标的优势在种子之间不太一致,直接的象征规则仍然比两个臂都准确得多. 然后我们跟随静态初始化,进入任务匹配的连续融合研究中,保存在线更新相对于重置记录的队列是有害的. 对比表明,为什么需要单独衡量反馈响应、启动政策的质量以及持续的在线福利。

blocks.en: This report specifies and implements a rank-4 input residual with slow initialization and episode-local fast state, including its gradient path through a frozen mixer and its reset and resume operations. It compares static and post-adaptation training with paired initializations, then measures real and sham feedback crossed with keep and reset reads. The factor-space analysis explains how an input residual changes the computation and why identical factor products can have different subsequent updates. Six episodic initializations and three task-matched initializations were trained and saved along this sequence.
blocks.zh: 本报告具体说明并实施了四级输入残存,初始化缓慢,插曲-局部快速状态,包括通过冷冻搅拌机的梯度路径,以及重设和恢复操作. 它将静态和适应后训练与配对初始化进行比较,然后测量真实和虚假的反馈与保存和重置读物交叉。 要素空间分析解释了输入剩余部分如何改变计算,以及为何相同的要素产品可以有不同的后续更新. 6个零星的初始化和3个任务匹配的初始化被按照这个序列进行培训和保存.

blocks.en: 6.1  Chronological replay and task-matched training
blocks.zh: 6.1 编年史再演和任务匹配培训

blocks.en: The second study predicts whether a public continuous-integration job will finish as success, failure, cancelled, or other. A job is predicted at its recorded start time. Its label becomes available at completion. At a timestamp with both starts and completions, predictions precede feedback processing. Updates use the prompt saved at prediction time. This ordering prevents later outcomes or memory contents from entering an earlier prediction.
blocks.zh: 第二项研究预测公共连续融合工作是否将以成功、失败、取消或其他方式完成。 一项工作预计在其记录的起始时间开始。 其标签在完成时即可使用。 在同时开始和完成的时间戳上,预测先于反馈处理. 更新使用预测时保存的提示 。 此命令防止后期结果或内存内容输入更早的预测.

blocks.en: The training queue has 2,678 jobs from 60 repository–commit groups. The audit queue has 3,321 jobs from 72 groups: 83 NumPy jobs from one commit and 3,238 pandas jobs from 71 commits. The NumPy training and audit dates are May 14 and May 16, 2026; the pandas dates are September 17 and September 19. Time is ordered within each repository. Because the shared training pool includes September pandas jobs, this is a repository-local retrospective evaluation, rather than a global-calendar prospective deployment.

blocks.en: Each selected static initialization receives one epoch of task-matched supervised training, using both no-memory and causal-memory views of each job. The loss is categorical cross-entropy on the four candidate-label energies, weighted equally by repository, commit within repository, job within commit, and the two views. AdamW uses the episodic outer hyperparameters. Each seed completes 670 additional updates, moving from slow version 256 to 926. The resulting three slow states are fixed during audit.
blocks.zh: 每个选定的静态初始化都接受一个任务相匹配的监管培训时代,同时使用每项工作的无记忆和因果记忆观点。 这种损失在四种候选标签能量上绝对是交叉的,按存放地点、存放地点内的承诺、承付范围内的工作以及两种观点等量加权。 亚当W使用偶发的外侧超参数. 每个种子完成670个附加更新,从慢版256向926移动. 由此产生的三个缓慢状态在审计期间得到固定。

blocks.en: The online policy uses SGD with step size 0.1 on arrived-label cross-entropy, with independent fast states for each path and repository. A separate memory stores at most 16 completed cases within 16 KiB and exposes at most two, preferring the same workflow and job name. It is updated from real completed labels in every relevant branch. The memory uses FIFO eviction; reading prefers the latest matching cases and fills any remaining slot with recent cases. Commit identifiers are exposed in the prompt, but do not impose a hard version filter. The policy-state intervention keeps online factors ( P 1 P_{1} ) or reads at the trained initialization ( P 0 P_{0} ). The memory intervention provides or omits these case records ( M 1 M_{1} or M 0 M_{0} ). A permuted-label path draws a fresh, independent uniform permutation of the four labels for each arrived job using its private random stream, then applies the inverse permutation to that job’s target. It retains the same real memory. There is no single fixed permutation shared by a completion batch.
blocks.zh: 在线政策使用SGD,步骤大小为0.1在到达-标签交叉连接上,每个路径和寄存器都有独立的快速状态. 在16个KiB范围内,最多16个已完成的个案中单独设有一个内存存储处,最多暴露两个,更喜欢相同的工作流程和工作名称. 它从每个相关分支实际完成的标签中更新。 内存使用FIFO拆迁;阅读偏爱最新的匹配案例,并用最近的案例填充任何剩余的插槽. 提交标识符在提示中被曝光, 但不要强制硬版过滤 。 政策状态干预保持在线因子(P1 P_{1}),或在经过培训的初始化(P0 P_{0})时阅读. 内存干预提供或省略这些案例记录(M 1 M_{1}或M 0 M_{0}). 标签路径使用私人随机流为每个到达的工作绘制四个标签的新鲜、独立的统一布局,然后对该工作的目标应用反布局。 它保留了同样的真实记忆. 没有一个完成批次共用的单一固定轮廓。

blocks.en: All jobs completing at the same timestamp form one feedback batch. Stable identifiers determine serialization within a timestamp, without implying finer temporal resolution. For each active path, gradients are the mean cross-entropy over its arrived jobs; physical chunks accumulate that same mean. They are not divided by the number of paths or seeds and do not use the commit weights of the outer training objective. Each path then takes one functional SGD step with no momentum, decay, or gradient clipping. All factor updates finish before real cases are committed to memory.
blocks.zh: 所有在同一时间戳完成的工作组成一个反馈批次。 稳定的识别器在一个时间戳内确定序列化,而不会暗示更精细的时间分辨率. 对于每一个活动路径,梯度是其到达工作上的平均跨纵横;物理块累积着同样的平均值. 它们不按路径或种子数量划分,也不使用外部训练目标的承诺重量。 每个路径然后采取一个功能性的SGD步骤,没有动力、衰变或梯度剪切。 所有因数更新在实际案件承诺内存前完成.

blocks.en: At audit start, task-trained policy paths copy their own version-926 ρ \rho . Case memory is initialized from each repository’s completed training history. The original and calibrated reference policies first process the pooled training labels through their own fast updates, then fork into independent audit sessions. HEDGE4 also processes the same pooled training history before the audit. Historical supervision is therefore available to every comparator through its declared learning mechanism.
blocks.zh: 在审计开始时,经过任务训练的政策路径会复制他们自己的版本-926 $\rho 。 案件记忆从每个存放处完成的培训历史中初始化。 原始和校准的参考政策首先通过自己的快速更新处理集合培训标签,然后叉入独立审计课程。 HEDGE4还在审计前处理同样的集合培训历史. 因此,每个比较国都可以通过其申报的学习机制进行历史监督。

blocks.en: HEDGE4 is the four-expert comparator constructed for this study, using an exponential-weights mixture [ 7 ] . Its experts are a smoothed workflow-frequency prior, a last-label predictor for the workflow/job key, a last-label predictor for the commit/workflow/job key, and hashed-feature logistic regression. It updates mixture weights using prediction-time losses after labels arrive. We evaluate this delayed-feedback combination by its observed prediction loss. Every method receives the same externally available history; their computation costs differ.
blocks.zh: HEDGE4是本研究的四位专家参照者,使用指数加权混合物[7]. 其专家是平滑的工作流程频率的前身、工作流程/工作密钥的最后标签预测器、承诺/工作流程/工作密钥的最后标签预测器,以及散列式后勤回归。 它利用标签到达后的预测时间损失来更新混合物权重. 我们通过观测到的预测损失来评估这种延迟反馈组合。 每一种方法都得到相同的外部历史;其计算成本各不相同。

blocks.en: This replay extends the lifetime of the fast state. In the episodic study, two updates precede one designated query. Here each completed batch can update the same factors that will be used for many later jobs. The distribution of arriving labels can differ from the distribution of jobs currently starting, and their order is set by completion times. A locally fitted update can therefore carry evidence from a narrow or delayed part of the workload into a different prediction population.
blocks.zh: 这个重播延长了快状态的寿命. 在零星的研究中,两个更新先于一个指定的查询. 在此,每个已完成的批次可更新用于以后许多工作的相同因素。 到达标签的分布可能与目前开始的工作分配不同,它们的顺序由完成时间来设定. 因此,根据当地情况进行更新,可以从工作量的狭小或延迟部分输入不同的预测人口。

blocks.en: 6.2  Prediction quality and retained state
blocks.zh: 6.2 预测质量和保留状态

(19) We average jobs within commits, commits within repositories, and the two repositories equally. Seed means and sample standard deviations are reported separately. The primary success rule requires HEDGE4 minus P 1 ​ M 1 P_{1}M_{1} to average at least 0.01 and be positive for all three seeds.

blocks.en: The full path scores 0.1808 compared with HEDGE4’s 0.1024, a gain of − 0.0784 -0.0784 that is negative for every seed. Reading at the trained initialization with real memory scores 0.1274. Consequently, retaining the real-feedback numerical state has G = − 0.0534 G=-0.0534 . Real feedback still outperforms permuted feedback by D = 0.1497 D=0.1497 . These measurements separate two observations: correct feedback is less harmful than permuted feedback, while both continuous numerical updating and the full path remain worse than their respective comparators.

blocks.en: Without explicit memory, retention also increases loss, from 0.1286 to 0.1726. The memory effect and policy-by-memory interaction vary in sign across seeds. NumPy contributes one all-success commit; the equal-repository average gives that single group half the weight. A pandas commit receives weight 1 / 142 1/142 , so the single NumPy commit carries 71 times its weight. We report this queue descriptively, without treating training seeds as additional independent jobs or attaching a population confidence interval to the two-repository result.
blocks.zh: 如果没有明确的内存,保留也会增加损失,从0.1286增加到0.1726. 记忆效应和逐项政策互动因种子而异。 NumPy贡献了一个全部成功的承诺;平均等重负使该单一群体拥有一半的权重。 一只熊猫承诺得到体重1/1421/142,所以单NumPy承诺的重量为71倍. 我们以描述方式报告这一队列,而不将培训种子作为额外的独立工作,也不将人口信心间隔与两个储存结果挂钩。

Rows labeled All weight commits equally within a repository; individual-label rows weight jobs equally within that label. Reset, Keep, and Permuted all use real memory. Label strata are descriptive and overlap in their commit membership.
blocks.zh: 表8:按寄存器和观察标签分列的CI半Brier损失,平均为三种种子。 标签行 所有权重在寄存器内平等承担;个人标签行权重在该标签内平等承担。 重置、保存和Permuted都使用真实的记忆。 标签层是描述性的,其承诺成员重叠。

blocks.en: The decomposition locates the retained-state harm primarily in pandas (Table 8 ). Keep slightly improves the one all-success NumPy commit, from 0.0300 to 0.0273. For pandas it raises commit-weighted loss from 0.2248 to 0.3343. Its job-weighted losses are lower on failures and cancellations but higher on successes and other outcomes. These strata describe where the error occurs; they do not identify which update caused it.
blocks.zh: 分解物主要在熊猫体内定位保留状态的伤害(表8 ). 保持稍有改进的全成功NumPy承诺,从0.0300到0.0273. 对熊猫来说,承诺加权损失从0.2248提高到0.3343。 其工作加权损失在失败和取消方面较低,但在成功和其他结果方面则较高。 这些层描述错误发生的地方;它们没有识别导致错误的更新。

blocks.en: Table 9: Weighting sensitivity on the same saved 3,321 predictions per seed. The first row remains the registered primary measure. The other rows are descriptive; neither introduces new jobs, retraining, or a replacement success rule.
blocks.zh: 表9:同一种子的加权敏感性节省了3,321个预测。 第一行仍然是登记的主要措施。 其他各行都是描述性的;既不引入新的工作、再培训,也不引入替代成功规则。

blocks.en: The absolute scores depend on repository weighting, but the ordering HEDGE4, reset, keep, permuted is preserved under all three aggregations (Table 9 ). Thus the observed harm of continuous retention is not removed by weighting commits or jobs globally.
blocks.zh: 绝对分数取决于寄存器的权重,但订购的HEDGE4重置,保存,穿透在所有三个集合下都保留下来(表9 ). 因此,无法通过加权承诺或全球工作来消除观察到的持续留用的危害。

blocks.en: 7  Separating Update Magnitude from Parameter History
blocks.zh: 7 从参数历史中分离更新

blocks.en: The CI replay records when predictions begin to degrade but does not retain every intermediate gradient or support loss. We therefore conducted one fixed follow-up intervention using the same trained slow states and a declared early prefix. It is a mechanism study on the already observed audit queue.
blocks.zh: CI在预测开始降解时重播记录,但不保留每一个中间梯度或支持损失. 因此,我们利用同样的训练有素的慢状态和宣布的早期前缀,进行了一次固定的后续干预。 这是对已经观察到的审计队列的机制研究。

blocks.en: The intervention crosses two choices. CARRY preserves the fast parameters across feedback batches; LATEST restores them to the bound ρ \rho before each batch. The second factor either applies the original SGD increment or multiplies its actual FP32 parameter difference by 0.1. We denote these settings by 1 and TENTH . The latter is defined on the realized parameter difference, rather than assumed to be bitwise identical to another learning-rate implementation. Memory, arrived feedback, and private random streams retain their prescribed lifetimes. RESET always reads the bound slow initialization.
blocks.zh: 干预涉及两个选择。 CARRY 保存跨反馈批次的快速参数; LATEST 在每批次前将它们恢复到 $\rho 。 第二个系数要么应用最初的SGD增量,要么将其实际FP32参数差乘以0.1。 我们以1和Tenth表示这些设置 。 后者是在已实现参数差异上定义的,而不是假设其位元与另一个学习率执行完全相同. 记忆,到达反馈,私人随机流保留规定的寿命. RESET总是读取捆绑的慢初始化.

blocks.en: The prefix includes all 83 NumPy jobs and 653 pandas jobs, totaling 736 predictions per seed. By its cutoff, 422 pandas labels have arrived in 128 batches; 231 remain pending. The pandas prefix intersects 13 commits, of which six are complete. We restrict the original full-queue job weights to this prefix and renormalize within each repository. This produces a prefix measure, not a new full-group test set. Saved HEDGE4 predictions are reused on the same jobs. The repeated CARRY_1 and RESET probabilities exactly match the original saved probabilities for all seeds.
blocks.zh: 前缀包括全部83个NumPy工作和653个大熊猫工作,每个种子总共736个预测. 截止其停产时,422只熊猫的标签已运抵128批;231只仍在等待处理. 大熊猫前缀交叉13个承诺,其中6个完成. 我们把原始的全排工作权重限制在这个前缀上,并且在每个寄存器内重新正常化. 这会产生前缀计量,而不是新的全组测试集. 已保存的HEDGE4预测在相同的工作上重复使用. 重复的 CARRY_1 和 RESET 概率完全匹配所有种子的原保存概率.

blocks.en: Table 10: Fixed-prefix diagnostic, half-Brier loss. The primary comparison is CARRY_1 minus CARRY_TENTH . All paths use the same prefix. Their losses use a different evaluation population from Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 表10:固定前置诊断,半Brier损失. 主要比较为CARRY_1减CARRY_TENTH. 所有路径都使用相同的前缀. 损失采用与表7不同的评价数据。

blocks.en: Reducing the carried update has a mean gain of − 0.0237 -0.0237 , with per-seed gains 0.0730, − 0.1459 -0.1459 , and 0.0017. It fails the fixed rule of a mean gain of at least 0.01 with all seeds positive. At the smaller increment, removing accumulated parameter history improves loss by 0.0976 on average and for every seed. At the original increment, the history-removal effect changes sign across seeds. All four active paths have higher mean loss than RESET , and each is worse than HEDGE4. LATEST_TENTH has the lowest mean loss among the four active paths, followed by LATEST_1 , CARRY_1 , and CARRY_TENTH .
blocks.zh: 减少载荷更新的平均收益为−0.0237-0.0237,每种子收益为0.0730、−0.1459-0.1459和0.0017。 它没有达到所有种子均质的至少0.01平均收益的固定规则。 在较小的增量中,去除累积参数历史使每个种子平均损失增加0.0976倍. 在原始增殖时,历史迁移效应会在整个种子中出现变化。 所有四个活动路径的平均损失都高于RESET,每条路径都比HEDGE4差. LATEST_TENTH在四个活动路径中平均损失最少,其次是LATEST_1,CARRY_1,和CARRY_TENTH.

blocks.en: 7.1  What happens on the first feedback batch?
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 在第一批反馈中会发生什么?

blocks.en: The first pandas feedback batch contains eight jobs labeled other. Three more other labels arrive in the next batch. At 01:16:06 UTC, after those two updates, all three original-update seeds have a local retained-state gain below − 0.01 -0.01 on the same 37 newly starting jobs. Those jobs later resolve to 24 successes and 13 cancellations. This is a descriptive local marker; the first cumulative crossing occurs after 2, 421, and 25 feedback batches for the three seeds, respectively.
blocks.zh: 第一批大熊猫反馈批次包含8个被标记为其他的工作. 下一批还有另外三个标签到达. UTC凌晨1点16分06分,经过这两个更新后,三个原更新种子的本地保留状态增益均低于−0.01-0.01,相同37个新开始的工作. 这些工作后来决心取得24项成功和13项取消。 此为描述性局部标志;三种种子分别经过2,421次和25次反馈批次后,首次累计通过.

blocks.en: Table 11: Cross-entropy on the same first pandas feedback batch, before and after the numerical update. Increment norm is the Euclidean norm across the two factor tensors.
blocks.zh: 表11:同一首个熊猫反馈批次上的交叉交替,数字更新前后. 增量规范是欧几利得规范,跨越两个因数的角.

blocks.en: The original update increases same-batch cross-entropy for all three seeds (Table 11 ). At that point, the feedback itself is not being fit better. The observation identifies local non-descent under the implemented update, which is distinct from a support-loss decrease followed by poor generalization. The smaller increment reduces same-batch loss for two seeds and increases it for the third. The pre- and post-update losses use the same saved prompts, candidate labels, masks, positions, and per-path batch-mean normalization. The pre-update gradient traverses the mixer with non-reentrant activation checkpointing; the post-update measurement uses a no-gradient forward. The substrate stays in evaluation mode, with BF16 computation and FP32 factors. These are matched loss definitions, not a guarantee of identical numerical kernel paths. Step size, factor geometry, model curvature, and finite-precision arithmetic have not been independently separated by this intervention.
blocks.zh: 最初的更新增加了所有三种种子的同型插管(表11). 当时,反馈本身并不适合。 观察发现,在执行的更新中存在当地非血统问题,这与支助损失减少和一般化程度差的情况不同。 较小的递增会减少两个种子的同囊损失,增加第三个种子. 更新前和更新后的损失使用相同的节省的提示,候选标签,口罩,位置,以及每条路径的批量正常化. 更新前的梯度会用非累进激活检查器穿过搅拌器;更新后测量使用无梯度前行. 底物保持评价模式,有BF16计算和FP32因子. 这些是匹配的损失定义,而不是相同的内核路径的保证. 步法大小,因子几何,模型曲率,以及有限精度算术,都没有被这种干预独立分离出来.

blocks.en: Across the full diagnostic prefix, the smaller CARRY path has lower average support loss before and after updates, yet worse mean future half-Brier loss. The selected update batch and the later prediction population thus answer different questions. Feedback delay and class composition offer plausible mechanisms for this divergence, but their individual causal contributions require different interventions. A support-loss decrease alone is insufficient evidence that an online update is useful.
blocks.zh: 在整个诊断前缀中,较小的CARRY路径在更新前后的平均支持损失较低,但更糟糕的是,未来的半Brier损失。 因此,选定的更新批次和后来的预测数量回答了不同的问题。 反馈延迟和分类构成为这种分歧提供了可信的机制,但是它们的个别因果贡献需要不同的干预。 仅仅减少支助损失不足以证明网上更新是有用的。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Three views of online learning. (a) The full 3,321-job replay compares real-memory paths at reset, retained real-feedback state, permuted-feedback state, and HEDGE4. (b) Same-batch CE change on the first eight pandas feedback jobs: positive values indicate non-descent. (c) The fixed 736-job diagnostic prefix: original carried-update loss minus the smaller carried-update loss, separately for each seed. The latter two panels describe a diagnostic on the observed queue; their populations and losses are distinct from panel (a).
blocks.zh: 图6:网上学习的三种观点. (a) 完整的3 321-工作重播在重置时比较真实的记忆路径,保留真实的反馈状态,穿梭的反馈状态,以及HEDGE4. (b) 头八只大熊猫反馈工作的相同批量CE变化:正值表示非血统。 (c) 固定的736个工作诊断前缀:原载更新日期损失减去较小的载更新日期损失,分别针对每个种子。 后两个小组描述了对所观察到排队情况的诊断;其数量和损失不同于小组(a)。

blocks.en: Read together, the panels in Figure 6 separate three stages of an update’s effect. The full replay measures the consequence of retaining a learning trajectory. The first-batch measurement asks whether the update improves the batch that generated its gradient. The prefix intervention changes the realized step magnitude while preserving the comparison population. The original step fails locally at the first batch; shrinking it changes that local behavior without producing a consistent future-risk improvement across seeds. This is the specific failure pattern a subsequent update controller has to address.
blocks.zh: 将图6中的面板放在一起阅读,可以分出更新效果的三个阶段。 完整的重播测量了保留学习轨迹的后果. 第一批的测量方法询问更新是否改善了生成梯度的批量. 前缀干预会改变已实现的步数,同时保留比较人口. 最初的一步在第一批时局部失效;缩小后会改变当地的行为,而不会对种子产生一致的未来风险改进. 这是后续更新控制器必须处理的具体故障模式 。

blocks.en: 8  Implementation, Cost, and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 8 执行、费用和可复制性

blocks.en: The episodic run uses PyTorch 2.11.0, Transformers 5.12.1, CUDA 12.8, and one RTX 4090. The substrate is BF16 and LARC factors are FP32. A physical batch has eight sequences of length 512, including padding. Prompt and answer limits are 384 and 32 tokens, respectively, and programs are scored with their complete end-of-sequence token. The mean-token scoring convention is used in both studies.
blocks.zh: 偶发运行使用PyTorch 2.11.0,变形金刚5.12.1,CUDA 12.8和1个RTX 4090. 底物为BF16,LARC因子为FP32. 一个物理批次有8个长度512的序列,包括贴板. 即时和答题限制分别为384个和32个令牌,节目以完整的序号令牌打分. 两项研究均采用中肯评分惯例。

blocks.zh: 数据建设成本和源头审查成本与执行项目单列.

blocks.en: The CI run encountered a pending-feedback capacity stop after task-fit training. The completed replay reused the saved slow models and restarted the audit from its beginning, counting the repeated evaluation in full. Pending records were compacted to store the two distinct prompt strings, plain and remembered, once per job. blocks.en: 8.1  The state boundary in an implementation
blocks.zh: 第8.1条 执行中的国家边界

blocks.en: A minimal implementation needs three operations. Begin copies the factors from the requested slow version and initializes the episode’s private update state. Update consumes only feedback that has arrived, computes its declared loss through the frozen reader, and replaces that episode’s fast factors. Read evaluates the current prompt and candidates using the designated factors. Keeping these operations distinct makes the update lifetime visible in the code and in the resulting checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 最低限度的执行需要三项行动。 从请求的慢版本开始复制因素,并初始化该集的私人更新状态. 更新只消耗已经到来的反馈,通过冷冻的读者计算其宣布的损失,并取代该集的快速因素. 读取使用指定因素评价当前快速和候选人。 保持这些业务的区别,可使更新寿命在代码和由此而来的检查站中可见。

blocks.en: The inner optimizer here is functional SGD, so there are no momentum tensors to carry between steps. Factors, step count, and the private random stream still belong to the episode. The outer AdamW optimizer owns different state attached to ρ \rho . Slow versions prevent an episode from silently resetting to an initialization that changed after it began. This is especially useful when many independent episodes share a physical batch.
blocks.zh: 这里的内置优化器是功能性的SGD,所以在台阶之间没有动力拉伸器可携带. 因素,步数,和私人随机流仍然属于剧集. 外 AdamW 优化器 拥有 $\rho 上不同的状态 。 慢版本阻止一集静默地重置为开始后改变的初始化. 当许多独立事件共用一个物理批次时,这尤其有用.

blocks.en: At an input boundary, cached embeddings are reusable only while their tokenization and frozen substrate match. Once LARC has changed the representation, the downstream activations depend on Φ \Phi . A cached mixer output or key–value state from another factor version would evaluate a different function from Equation ( 1 ). The implementation therefore recomputes the mixer with the current factors, preserves attention masks and positions, and uses activation checkpointing to trade computation for memory during backpropagation.
blocks.zh: 在一个输入边界上,缓存的嵌入物只有在其符号化和冷冻底物匹配时才能重新使用. 一旦LARC改变表示,下游激活依赖于QQ\Phi. 从另一个因数版本中缓存的混音器输出或密钥 - 值状态将评价与方程式(1)不同的函数. 因此,执行会将混音器与当前因子重新计算,保存注意力罩和位置,并使用激活检查点来进行交易计算,以在反向传播时进行内存.

blocks.en: In the delayed-feedback setting, the pending record is also part of the learning state. It retains the prompt used for the original prediction and the information needed to score the eventual label against that prediction. Rebuilding the prompt from current memory at completion would train on a different observation. Saving only the factor matrices would likewise leave restoration unable to determine which feedback belongs to which earlier read.
blocks.zh: 在延迟反馈设定中,待决记录也是学习状态的一部分. 它保留了用于原始预测的提示,以及对照该预测对最终标签进行评分所需的信息. 从当前内存中重建完成的提示,将训练不同的观察。 只保存因数矩阵同样会使恢复无法确定哪些反馈属于较早的。

blocks.en: 9  Discussion
blocks.zh: 9 讨论情况

blocks.en: The program-selection study shows that feedback written into this trained rank-4 input residual reduces expected query execution error with the query read otherwise fixed. The target is already among four supplied programs, and the direct support-loss rule remains much more accurate. Within that setting, the retained factors provide a measurable path from feedback to a better probability distribution. Comparing final errors separately from gains over reset also clarifies why both objectives support adaptation, while the fixed worst-seed stability rule selects static training despite its higher mean endpoint error.
blocks.zh: 程序选择研究显示,写进这个训练有素的等级-4输入残存的反馈可以减少预期的查询执行错误,而查询读取的则是其他固定的. 目标已经属于四个提供方案,直接支助损失规则仍然更加准确。 在这一背景下,保留的因素提供了一个从反馈到更好的概率分布的可衡量途径。 将最后错误与收益与重置分开比较也澄清了为什么两个目标都支持适应,而固定的最坏种子稳定性规则选择静态训练,尽管其平均终点错误较高。

blocks.en: The continuous-integration study changes the learning regime from two updates on a small controlled support set to accumulated updates with delayed labels. In this repository-local retrospective queue, the repository-balanced result favors the trained reset reference over retained online state, and HEDGE4 remains stronger than the full neural path. The follow-up intervention records both same-batch non-descent and a lack of consistent future benefit from shrinking updates. It makes update size and parameter history concrete design questions, while leaving the causes of failure unresolved. Rank alone controls neither local descent nor usefulness on later predictions.
blocks.zh: 持续整合研究改变了学习制度,从两个关于小控制支持集的更新改为带有延迟标签的累积更新. 在这个寄存器-本地追溯队列中,寄存器-均衡结果偏向于训练后的重置引用而不是保留在线状态,HEDGE4仍然比完整的神经路径更强大. 后续干预既记录了同一批非血统,也记录了因更新不断缩减而缺乏连贯一致的未来效益. 它使更新大小和参数历史具体设计问题得以解决,同时使失败的原因得不到解决. 单靠排名不能控制本地的血统,也不能控制以后的预测。

blocks.en: The available evidence covers one frozen language-model substrate, one rank, finite candidate decisions, and three training seeds. Comparisons with untrained initialization on the same task groups, alternative residual ranks and insertion boundaries, and matched weight-space LoRA or nonlinear adapters remain unrun. The results characterize the evaluated LARC realization and do not measure a performance advantage over those alternatives. The program results are development evidence; the CI intervention reuses an observed audit population.
blocks.zh: 现有证据包括一个冻结的语言模型底物、一个等级、有限的候选人决定以及三个培训种子。 与未经过训练的相同任务组的初始化、替代剩余等级和插入界限以及匹配的重量空间LORA或非线性适配器的比较仍未运行。 评价结果是评价的LARC实现情况的特点,没有衡量这些替代办法的绩效优势。 方案成果是发展证据;CI干预重新使用观察到的审计人口。

blocks.en: A learning-state specification must describe both the current prediction and the next update. Resuming factor-space learning requires the factors and any optimizer state; the product B ​ A BA describes the current linear correction alone. A trained reset reference measures the effect of retaining updates, and a strong direct-feedback comparator measures how useful the resulting policy is. Within MMLA, these findings motivate evaluating a controller that uses arrived-batch fitting and later outcomes to decide whether to retain an update. Such a controller remains a next study, with independent task groups and the existing comparators needed to assess it.
blocks.zh: 学习状态的规格必须说明目前的预测和下一次更新。 恢复因子-空间学习需要因素和任何优化状态;产品B ABA单独描述当前线性修正. 训练有素的重设参考标准衡量保留更新的效果,以及强有力的直接反馈参照标准衡量由此产生的政策是否有用。 在MMLA中,这些结论激励着评价一个使用到货批装以及后来的结果来决定是否保留更新的控制器. 这样一个控制员仍然是下一个研究,需要独立的任务小组和现有的比较者进行评估。

blocks.en: 10  Relation to Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 10 与现行方法的关系

blocks.en: Residual networks learn a correction relative to a reference path [ 8 ] . ReZero initializes residual branches through a zero-valued scalar gate [ 2 ] . Adapter modules train compact additions to a frozen pretrained network [ 9 ] . LoRA parameterizes weight corrections with low-rank factors [ 10 ] ; Section 3 gives the linear relationship to an input-side residual and identifies the insertion boundary used here.
blocks.zh: 残存网络与参考路径相对学习校正[8]. ReZero通过一个零值的scalar门初始化残余分支[2]. 适配器模块培训对冷冻预训网络的紧凑添加[9]. LoRA参数化了低阶因子的重量校正[10];第3节给出了输入侧残基的线性关系,并确定了此处使用的插入边界.

blocks.en: Fast weights provide an intermediate timescale between neural activities and slowly trained parameters [ 1 ] . MAML trains initial parameters for rapid task adaptation [ 6 ] , and its first-order approximation omits support-loss Hessians [ 12 ] . Equation ( 5 ) applies that estimator to the input-residual factors, with ordinary query-risk training as the matched static objective.
blocks.zh: 快速加权提供了神经活动和缓慢训练的参数之间的中间时间尺度 [1]. MAML列车进行快速任务适应的初始参数[6],其一级近似省略了支持-损失的赫西安[12]. 方程式(5 )将该估计值适用于输入-剩余因素,普通的查询-风险培训作为匹配的静态目标.

blocks.en: Block et al. [ 4 ] study retraining objectives that prepare model weights for later low-rank adaptation and give performance guarantees in a linear setting. ABMLL [ 16 ] uses low-rank forms to model global and task-specific parameter distributions for Bayesian adaptation across datasets. Here the pretrained substrate is fixed, the learned initialization is a deterministic pair of input-residual factors, and the experiments measure feedback-retention effects with real/sham and keep/reset interventions. These differences specify the objects trained and evaluated in the respective studies.
blocks.zh: Block等人 (英语). [4] 研究再培训目标,为后来的低等级适应准备模型权重,并在线性环境下提供性能保证. ABMLL [16] 使用低排名的表格,为贝叶斯人跨数据集的适应性建立全球和任务特定参数分布模型. 在这里,预先训练的底物是固定的,所学的初始化是一对决定性的输入-剩余因子,实验用真/假来测量反馈-保留效果,并保持/重置干预. 这些差异具体说明了相关研究中培训和评价的对象。

blocks.en: Test-time training adapts model parameters through a self-supervised objective at test time [ 15 ] . TTT layers instead make the sequence state a model that is updated by learning [ 14 ] . Titans develops neural memory that learns historical context [ 3 ] . Our experiments use external execution feedback or completed-job labels, with state resets that isolate their effect. Within MMLA, LARC occupies the numerical policy plane; explicit stored records retain a separate memory lifetime.
blocks.zh: 测试时间训练通过测试时间的自我监督目标调整模型参数[15]. TTT层相反使序列状态成为通过学习更新的模型[14]. 泰坦斯发展了学习历史背景的神经记忆[3]. 我们的实验使用外部执行反馈或完成的工作标签,有状态重排来隔离其效果. 在MMLA内部,LARC占据数字政策平面;明文存储的记录保留单独的内存寿命.

blocks.en: 11  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11 结论

blocks.en: LARC realizes a numerical policy state with the low-rank map h + B ​ A ​ h h+BAh , a trained starting point, private feedback updates, and defined reset and resume operations. In the four-candidate development task, two gradient steps reduce expected query execution error relative to each trained reset, while a direct support-loss rule remains much more accurate. In the CI replay, retained updates increase later loss, and the diagnostic also records local non-descent. These measurements connect the residual’s factor-space dynamics to the practical question of when a small numerical learning state should be retained.

blocks.en: C.2  What reset removes
blocks.zh: C.2 联合国 重置什么会删除

blocks.en: In the episodic intervention, reset is applied after the second inner update and before the deterministic query read. It restores the episode’s trained ρ \rho , clears inner optimizer and cached fast-dependent representations, and restores the private episode random state. Real/reset and sham/reset therefore have equal predictions. The trained B ρ B_{\rho} is retained.
blocks.zh: 在偶发性干预中,重置在第二次内更新后和决定性查询读取前应用. 它恢复了该集训练有素的 ^ \rho ,清除了内在优化和缓存的快速依赖性表现,并恢复了私人插曲的随机状态. 因此,真实的/重置和假的/重置有相同的预测。 训练有素的B&B_{\rho}被保留下来。

blocks.en: C.3  CI observations, labels, and baseline parameters
blocks.zh: C.3 CI 观测、标签和基准参数

blocks.en: The prediction interface contains exactly seven fields: repository name, workflow identifier, workflow path, event type, job name, commit identifier, and recorded start time. The prompt asks for the eventual status and serializes these fields with the selected completed-history cases. Each case exposes its workflow identifier, job name, commit identifier, and arrived result. Current-job completion time and conclusion are absent. Four literal answer strings, success , failure , cancelled , and other , are scored with their end-of-sequence token using the mean-log-probability policy.
blocks.zh: 预测界面包含完全7个字段:寄存器名称,工作流程标识符,工作流程路径,事件类型,工作名称,承诺标识符,以及记录的开始时间. 即时通知要求最终地位,并将这些字段与选定的已完成的历史案件序列化。 每个案件都披露其工作流程标识符、工作名称、承诺标识符和抵达结果。 目前的工作没有完成时间和结束。 四个字形的回答字符串,成功,失败,取消,以及其他,使用平均日志概率政策,用其序列结束符记分.

blocks.en: The source conclusions success , failure , and cancelled map to labels 0, 1, and 2. Conclusions timed_out , action_required , neutral , skipped , and stale map to label 3, other . Noncompleted jobs, unrecognized conclusions, and invalid or missing timestamps are excluded. Commit groups shared across training and audit or exposed in the earlier queue are excluded as groups. The public input is the same for the neural predictors and HEDGE4. The neural path scores label strings, whereas HEDGE4 directly predicts the four class probabilities.
blocks.zh: 源结论成功, 失败, 并取消地图标签为 0, 1, 2 。 结论超时_ 退出, 动作_ 需要, 中性, 跳过, 和 Stale 映射到标签 3, 其他 。 未完成的工作、未确认的结论以及无效或缺失的时间戳不包括在内。 在整个培训和审计期间共享的或先前排队中暴露的团体不列为团体。 对神经预测器和HEDGE4的公开输入相同. 神经路径评分为标签字符串,而HEDGE4则直接预测四类概率.

blocks.en: HEDGE4 uses 4,096 keys per bounded statistics map, 1,024 hashed unigram/bigram features, logistic learning rate 0.1, and logistic weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Mixture weights are proportional to exp ⁡ ( − L j ) \exp(-L_{j}) , where L j L_{j} is the expert’s accumulated prediction-time half-Brier loss observed through arrived feedback. A workflow prior uses Laplace smoothing. The latest workflow/job label receives probability 0.7 and each alternative 0.1; the exact commit/workflow/job label receives 0.97 and each alternative 0.01. Missing keys fall back to the prior. Updates sharing a completion timestamp are processed as a batch.
blocks.zh: HEDGE4使用4,096个按方位统计图键,1,024个散列单方格/双方格特征,后勤学习率0.1,后勤重量衰减10−4 10^{-4}。 Lj L_{j)是专家通过抵达反馈观察到的累计预测时间半Brier损失。 前一个工作流程使用 Laplace 平滑 。 最新的工作流程/工作标签得到概率0.7,每个备选案文0.1;准确的承诺/工作流程/工作标签得到0.97,每个备选案文0.01。 缺少的密钥会回到前面 。 共享完成时间戳的更新作为批次处理.

blocks.en: The calibrated neural control fits four fixed additive label biases by weighted historical cross-entropy with an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} coefficient of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . It uses CPU float64 L-BFGS, at most 100 iterations and 125 function evaluations, then subtracts the mean bias. Fast updates for that control use the calibrated energies; the bias persists across fast-state replacements. This control tests a fitted class bias together with its prescribed adaptation path.
blocks.zh: 校准的神经控制符合四个固定的添加剂标签偏差 通过加权的历史交叉连接,其系数为l 2\ell\2}系数为10−4 10{4}。 它使用CPU浮式64L-BFGS,最多100次迭代和125次函数评价,然后减去平均偏差. 快速更新的控制使用校准的能量;在快速状态替换中,这种偏差仍然存在。 这种控制测试一种装配的等级偏差及其规定的适应路径。
